semiconductor_relevance: High — CEA-Leti is a leading research institute focused on advancing micro and nanotechnologies within the semiconductor value chain.
summary: CEA-Leti is a prominent research institute specializing in the development and transfer of innovative micro and nanotechnologies for the semiconductor industry. It operates a state-of-the-art clean room facility for processing 200mm and 300mm wafers, supporting continuous operations and fostering collaborations to enhance industry competitiveness.

regional_presence.Japan: Active role in events like Leti Innovation Days Tokyo, focusing on scaling innovation in semiconductors.
